title: LiveVA Hypixel Skyblock
description: A premium Fabric mod for Hypixel Skyblock. Automate your party invites, manage dynamic chat bots, and control everything through a sleek in-game GUI.
body:
# 🚀 LiveVA Premium | The Ultimate Skyblock Assistant

**LiveVA** is a highly optimized, client-side Fabric mod built specifically to dominate your multiplayer experience on Hypixel Skyblock. It takes the annoyance out of repetitive tasks like party management, chat interactions, and RNG drop announcements, letting you focus 100% on grinding and flexing your loot.

*Note: This mod solely automates chat commands and provides visual/audio utilities. It strictly adheres to server rules and does NOT automate player movement, combat, or inventory management.*

---

## 🌟 The Ultimate Feature List

### 🎲 Advanced RNG Auto-Flex & Profit Engine

Never miss a chance to flex your insane luck! LiveVA intelligently tracks your high-value drops with completely independent controls for Chests and Chat drops.

* **Smart Dungeon Chest Scanner:** Instantly scans Obsidian and Bedrock chests. If it spots an RNG drop, it triggers a massive on-screen Title Alert.
* **The Ultimate Hybrid API System (NEW):** Fetches lag-free, 100% accurate live prices using a smart dual-layer system. It pulls Bazaar item prices directly from the **Official Hypixel API** and fetches high-tier AH drops (like Necron's Handle) directly from the **Coflnet Premium API**.
* **Real Profit Calculator (NEW):** No more fake flexes! The mod automatically deducts the dungeon chest cost (e.g., subtracting 100M for a Handle) from the live market value to calculate and broadcast your **Actual Profit** (e.g., `+650M Profit!`).
* **Smart API Fallback & Warnings (NEW):** If your Coflnet API key expires, the mod won't crash or spam you. It gives a one-time chat warning and safely falls back to highly accurate hardcoded prices to keep your runs smooth.
* **Slayer & Boss Auto-Flex:** Instantly detects `RARE DROP`, `CRAZY RARE DROP`, and `INSANE DROP` messages in your chat.
* **VIP Chat Actions ("Click-to-Flex"):** Whenever you get a rare drop, LiveVA generates a private message with interactive **`[ALL]`**, **`[PARTY]`**, and **`[GUILD]`** buttons. Just click one to instantly share your drop and Magic Find stats!

### 🤖 Dynamic Chat Bots

* **Smart `!who` Bot (NEW):** Dynamically reads your Minecraft username and replies automatically when someone types `!who`. It features smart channel routing (Guild, Party, or Private Message).
* **Auto-Welcome:** Greets new players joining your party/dungeon automatically. Use `{player}` to dynamically mention their name.
* **Dynamic Roast Bot (Auto-BOOM):** Roasts party members in chat when they die in a dungeon. (Safely ignores disconnects, ghosts, and your own deaths).
* **In-Game Math Engine:** Turn your chat into a calculator! Any player can type `!math <equation>` (e.g., `!math 250 * 4 + 10`) in chat, and your client will automatically calculate and reply with the correct answer.

### 🎛️ Premium In-Game GUI & Ghost UI

Manage all your settings without ever touching a config file!

* Press **`Right Shift`** (or type `/va`) to open a sleek, dark-themed interactive menu.
* **1-Click Ghost UI:** Type `/va list` or `/va listsounds` to view your active friends or sound triggers right in the chat. Click the red **`[✖]`** button next to any entry to instantly remove it—no typing required!
* **Instant Auto-Save:** Every click is instantly saved to your local config.

### 🤝 Smart Party & Guild Utilities

* **Whitelist Auto-Accept:** Add trusted friends to your whitelist. The mod will automatically accept their party invites within a second.
* **Smart `!p` Routing:** Automatically invite players who type `!p` in chat across Public Lobbies, Guild Chat, and Private Messages.
* **AFK Auto-Reply:** Going AFK? Turn on AFK mode. If someone sends a `!p` request, the mod auto-replies to them using your customizable AFK message.

### 🎵 Color-Proof Custom Audio Alerts

Never miss an important message or rare drop, even when tabbed out!

* Link any `.wav` audio file to a specific text trigger in chat.
* Strips all server color codes automatically, ensuring your custom sounds trigger 100% of the time without fail.
* Place your `.wav` files inside the `.minecraft/config/liveva_sounds/` folder.

---

## ⚙️ Commands Guide

Forget how to use a feature? Just type **`/va help`** in-game for a beautifully formatted list of all commands!

**Core Commands:**

* `/va setapikey <token>` - **(NEW)** Securely set your Coflnet API Token for live AH prices.
* `/va who` - Toggle the `!who` auto-reply bot ON or OFF.

**Whitelist Commands:**

* `/va add <player_name>` - Add a player to your auto-accept whitelist.
* `/va list` - Display everyone currently on your whitelist (Click `[✖]` to remove).

**Custom Message Commands:**

* `/va setwelcome <custom_message>` - Set your party join message (Use `{player}`).
* `/va setboom <custom_message>` - Set your dungeon death roast message (Use `{player}`).
* `/va setwho <custom_message>` - Set your `!who` auto-reply message (Use `{player}`).
* `/va setafk <custom_message>` - Set your custom AFK auto-reply message.

**Custom Sound Commands:**

* `/va addsound "<text_trigger>" <filename.wav>` - Bind a sound to chat text.
* `/va listsounds` - View all active sound triggers (Click `[✖]` to remove).

---

## 📥 Installation & Requirements

1. **Minecraft Version:** 1.20.X
2. **Mod Loader:** [Fabric Loader](https://fabricmc.net/)
3. **Dependencies:** [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api) is required for the mod to function correctly.
4. Download the latest `liveva-x.x.x.jar`.
5. Drop the `.jar` file into your `.minecraft/mods` folder and launch the game!

---
